entry_points.text: List registration links nothing; key requests use no domain or a namespace one with an RCU form; disabled dumps fail reads and refuse registration; remap forwards offset and length.
Erasable stack runs above the end magic to saved registers; init seeds the low marker from the bound, duplicated for metrics when enabled.

exports.text: Sleep checks gate on a predicate; unknown ids map to unknown; per-CPU readers cover current and numbered CPUs; key requests use an authority callback.
Remote coverage control, task setup/teardown, common-handle lookup and sanitizer init are empty in one configuration.
Module requests come in blocking, nonblocking and test-then-request forms; without a loader the first two fail unimplemented.

hazards.text: Inert key paths discard inputs; last-put holds its lock in cleanup; nonzero loads are trusted; conditional gets may race; stack scans assume ordered bounds.
Scheduler, barrier, per-CPU, reference-count, virtual-time and stack-limit helpers are owned elsewhere and were not routed here.
Prefixes pair start byte one with emergency-to-debug digits plus continuation; priorities add a default below emergency-to-debug.

invariants.text: One-bit mode and LED reads return zero-or-one; setters force on, clearers force off, togglers invert locks, modes and LEDs.
Minor spans twenty bits; legacy packing bounds parts below 256 with major above minor; extended layouts widen it; formatting prints decimal pair.
Switch bracketing sets a high flag around context switches, empty in one config; remote handles reject masked overflow with zero; softirq variants gate on softirq.
Disabled sanitizer checks, barriers, toggles, atomic brackets and scoped handling accept arguments without effect; scoped start returns its descriptor.
Yields vary by configuration including an empty form; sleep prohibition and nonblock bracketing adjust task state or vanish; dyntick-idle ticks skip time flush.
Read purposes cover firmware, modules, kexec image and initramfs, policy, certs, unknown and maximum; negate-and-link equals not-found rejection on the same ring.
Softirq increments hit caller CPU only with summed totals; snapshots are inert; generic reads divert idle/iowait with bulk refresh.
References encode possession in the low pointer bit; serial maps null to zero with acquire-ordered reads; positive matches its code, negative is below zero.
Serializable pointers share physical and virtual views; stores convert down, nonzero loads convert back, zero yields null; radix geometry derives from address and page widths.
New references start at one with plain reads; conditional gets need nonzero and last put runs cleanup; stack scanning counts trailing poison to the top non-poison word.

locks.text: Payloads publish by RCU assignment; RCU readers use RCU dereference, locked readers need the semaphore; reads take read lock, revocation write lock.
Last-put acquires the supplied mutex or spinlock before cleanup and returns holding it; bad-range lists carry their own spinlock.

state_machines.text: Coverage moves from disabled to initialized, then to program-counter tracing or comparison collection.
Boot advances from early boot through scheduler readiness and init release to running, then to halt, off, restart or suspend.
Keys admit uninstantiated and positively instantiated codes; rejections are negative values.
Public-key calls select encrypt, decrypt, sign or verify; dumps enumerate undefined, panic, oops, emergency and shutdown.

structs.text: Per-console keyboard state pairs modifier bytes with LED control and nibbles, a decode selector and mode toggles; LED selects flags or ioctl; decode spans table and raw; modes cover application and meta.
Core entries link address, length and category; CPU stats use bucket arrays with tickless idle state plus interrupt totals and softirq tables.
Access bits mark write, compound and atomic; scoped descriptors pair target, extent and attributes, empty in one config; thread context tracks disables, atomics and live scopes.

Key types bundle identity, quota, flags and hooks with randomized layout; proposals, matches, tags, indexes, payloads and restrictions feed lookup; keys chain identity, locks, quota, state and aliased views.
Serials are signed 32-bit and masks unsigned 32-bit; separate bytes hold possessor, user, group and other rights with ALL covers and an all-ones undefined mask.
Status includes dead, revoked, invalidated, builtin and keep with a debug magic; allocation covers in-quota, non-quota, builtin and restriction bypass.
Handover uses page-sized linked blocks; vmalloc chains chunked page arrays; live-update packs sessions and blobs by physical address; memfd packs position, size, seals and folios.
Notifications pair console, direction, modifiers, LEDs and value; pkey queries report ops and limits; dumps track sequences; probes map ranges; references wrap one counter.
